proposals.subtype: Search audience scope handling on builders
proposals.explanation: The customization script invokes addSearchAudienceScopeHandling on four client builders to adjust authentication scope/audience handling.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Applied by a Customization subclass AST edit on generated builders; the helper body is outside the supplied lines, so only the call sites are cited.

proposals.explanation: The script clears modifiers on generated searchWithResponse, autocompleteWithResponse and suggestWithResponse methods of SearchClient and SearchAsyncClient to make them non-public.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: AST edit in a customization script via setModifiers; comment states it works around a generator quirk exposing searchPost.
proposals.rootCauseHypothesis: Unmeasured hypothesis: the generator infers SearchOptions from searchPost parameters, forcing the operation public.

proposals.subtype: Preserve old and remove old preview service versions
proposals.explanation: The script adds older API versions to SearchServiceVersion and removes old preview versions.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Customization script edit of the generated enum via includeOldApiVersions/removeOldPreviewApiVersions; bodies not in supplied lines.

proposals.subtype: Remove generated get APIs from search clients
proposals.explanation: removeGetApis is applied to SearchClient and SearchAsyncClient to delete generated GET-based methods.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Customization script removal of generated methods; helper body not in supplied lines.

proposals.explanation: The script hides internal properties on the SearchDocumentsResult model.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Customization script AST edit; helper body not in supplied lines.

proposals.subtype: Hide BinaryData WithResponse protocol methods on all clients
proposals.explanation: hideWithResponseBinaryDataApis is applied to eight sync/async clients to make the BinaryData protocol methods non-public.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Customization script edit applied across clients; helper body not in supplied lines.

proposals.subtype: Typed SSE retrieveStream on knowledge base clients (Flux and listener)
proposals.explanation: The script replaces generated retrieveStream with Flux<ServerSentEvent<...>> (async) and listener-based (sync) methods that wrap a hidden generated protocol call and convert events, stopping at terminal events.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Methods are parsed from strings and inserted by a customization script; they delegate to hiddenGeneratedRetrieveStreamWithResponse and ServerSentEventStreams.
proposals.rootCauseHypothesis: Unmeasured hypothesis: comment says it is premature until native streaming support exists.

proposals.subtype: retrieveStream overloads with query source authorization headers
proposals.explanation: Additional retrieveStream overloads accept querySourceAuthorization and queryWorkIQSourceAuthorization and set them as x-ms-query-* request headers.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Overloads are inserted as parsed strings by the customization script and map parameters to headers manually.

proposals.subtype: Handwritten stream event model classes added as raw files
proposals.explanation: The script writes new stream event classes (base, unknown, and wrapper events for retrieval/activity/answer/references/error/response) through the raw editor.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Classes do not come from the TypeSpec model; they are emitted from Java source strings in the customization script.

proposals.explanation: The script rewrites fromJson to replace Duration.parse with KnowledgeSourceDurationParser.parse.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Body replacement via setBody on a generated method, guarded by a check for the generated parser text.

proposals.subtype: Repair synonym maps method and typed async knowledge base convenience methods
proposals.explanation: The script repairs an async synonym-maps convenience method and adds typed public async knowledge base wrappers mirroring sync hand-written methods.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Applied by customization script; comment says sync client already has hand-written equivalents. Helper bodies not in supplied lines.

proposals.explanation: A no-arg constructor is added because keyVaultUri/keyVaultKeyName are required in the spec but not when isServiceLevelKey is true.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Customization script edit with explanatory comment calling it a workaround.
proposals.rootCauseHypothesis: Unmeasured hypothesis: spec marks properties required that are conditionally optional.

proposals.explanation: Models expose setters taking varargs that wrap the array with Arrays.asList into the List property.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Setters have Javadoc but no @Generated annotation, unlike surrounding generated members.

proposals.explanation: Constructors accept varargs for the required list property and convert with Arrays.asList.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Constructors lack @Generated markers and add an overload shape beyond list-typed generated constructors.
